scope: A dedicated landscape image for the individual journey's Follow the review step. This illustrative photograph does not show the Ontiver interface or an actual request status.

contexts: src/features/individual/journey/pages/HowItWorksPage.tsx: Follow the review / Track progress as the request is checked
entries.reason: The journey step is about checking a request's progress from a personal device. A person reclining at home and looking at a smartphone illustrates that everyday action. Unlike the earlier portrait-format photograph, this landscape composition keeps the face and raised phone at a similar height, so both remain visible in the timeline's 1824:500 panorama and its 4:3 mobile view. Both crops were generated and visually checked at object-position 100% 62%. The pictured screen is not described as Ontiver or a literal status display.
